shortDescription: Manage an SSL Orchestrator Layer 3 security device

options.name: auto_manage
options.description: Specifies whether to provide a set of unique, non-overlapping, non-routable IP addresses to be used by the security service.

options.name: control_channels
options.description: service control channel definition, enabling you to create service control channel pathways. service control channels allow device-initiated traffic to egress to the Internet. Control channels are introduced in SSL Orchestrator 11.1.x. please use this feature for SSL Orchestrator 11.1.x and later. When you deploy a service configuration with a service control channel, the required destination-side listener (a virtual server) is created, and it is auto-bound to the destination-side VLAN of the se

options.name: devices
options.description: Defines a list of service IP addresses and ports.

options.name: devices_from
options.description: Specifies the set of network settings for traffic going to the BIG-IP from the service.

options.name: devices_to
options.description: Specifies the set of network settings for traffic going to the service from the BIG-IP.

options.name: dump_json
options.description: Sets the module to output a JSON blob for further consumption. When C(true), does not make any changes on the device and always returns C(changed=False). The output provided is idempotent in nature, meaning if there are no changes to be made during C(MODIFY) on an existing service, no JSON output is generated.

options.name: ip_family
options.description: Specifies the IP family used for attached L3 inline security devices.

options.name: monitor
options.description: Specifies the monitor attached to the L3 Inline security device pool. The monitor must already exist on the BIG-IP. When creating L3 Inline service if the parameter is not provided a default of C(/Common/gateway_icmp) is assumed.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the Layer 3 security service. The configuration auto-prepends C(ssloS_) to the service. The service name should be less than 14 characters and not contain dashes C(-).

options.name: port_remap
options.description: Defines the port to remap decrypted traffic to.

options.name: rules
options.description: Defines a list of iRules to attach to the service.

options.name: service_down_action
options.description: Specifies the action to take on monitor failure. Setting to C(ignore) bypasses the security device in the service chain. Setting to C(reset) or C(drop) resets or drops the connection, respectively, if the service monitor fails. When creating a L3 Inline service, if the parameter is not provided a default value of C(ignore) is assumed.

options.name: service_entry_sslprofile
options.description: Specifies the SSL profile used for the service entry. Introduced in SSL Orchestrator 11.1.x. Please use this feature for SSL Orchestrator 11.1.x and later.

options.name: service_return_sslprofile
options.description: Specifies the SSL profile used for the service return. Introduced in SSL Orchestrator 11.1.x. Please use this feature for SSL Orchestrator 11.1.x and later.

options.name: snat
options.description: Defines if and how a SNAT configuration is deployed. When C(none), no SNAT configuration is performed. This is the default choice when creating a L3 inline service if the parameter is not provided. When C(automap), SNAT automap is configured. When C(snatpool), the SNAT configuration points to existing SNAT Pool defined by the C(snatpool) parameter. When C(snatlist), a new SNAT Pool is created from the provided C(snatlist).

options.name: snat_list
options.description: Defines a list of IP addresses to use in a SNAT pool configuration. This parameter is required when C(snat) set to C(snatlist).

options.name: snat_pool
options.description: Defines an existing SNAT pool. This parameter is required when C(snat) is set to C(snatpool).

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the present/absent state required.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time to wait for the C(CREATE) or C(MODIFY) task to complete, in seconds. The accepted value range is between C(10) and C(1800) seconds.

options.name: use_exist_selfip
options.description: Specifies whether to use existing self-IPs.

options.name: vendor_info
options.description: Specifies the vendor-specific L3 service used. The default is C(Generic Inline Layer 3).
